name: Sharehouse
source:
Your scholarship leads you to a mysterious mansion with strange rules, strange happenings, and residents haunted by their own pasts. As forgotten memories begin to surface, you uncover the truth of the sharehouse and what your love will change.

[From [url=https://teamnyxian.itch.io/sharehouse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的奖学金将带你进入一座神秘的宅邸，里面有奇怪的规则、奇怪的事件，以及被自己的过去困扰的居民。随着被遗忘的记忆开始浮出水面，你揭开了合租屋的真相，以及你的爱情将会发生什么变化。

[来自[url=https://teamnyxian.itch.io/sharehouse]itch.io[/url]]
